events.title: Cook-Off 7.0: The 24-Hour Flagship Hackathon & CP Battle
events.subtitle: Blend debugging with pain, mix deadlines with chai — ABESEC’s ultimate overnight tech showdown.
events.venue: Aryabhatta Block Seminar Hall & Central Computing Lab
events.description: Our flagship 24-hour inter-branch hackathon & nocturnal algorithmic Cook-Off! Build full-stack AI/Web3/FinTech products during the day, survive midnight bug-hunts over unlimited kulhad chai, and compete in rapid-fire lightning CP rounds at 2:00 AM.
events.prerequisites: Laptop, College ID Card, GitHub Account, and appetite for 2 AM debugging.

agenda.stage: Problem Statements Unlocked & Kitchen Bell Rings 🔔
Mentorship Checkpoint 1 + Samosa & Chai Fuel Drop ☕
Midnight RedBull & 45-Min Lightning Bug-Smash Mini Contest
Final Git Freeze, Live Jury Pitching & Winner Coronation 🏆

events.title: CodeChef Starters ABESEC Edition: Mock ICPC & DSA Roast
events.subtitle: 3 Hours. 7 Algorithmic Dishes. Zero Mercy from Hidden Test Cases.
events.description: Think your O(N log N) solution won’t TLE? Step into the CP Station for a proctored ACM-ICPC style contest followed by a live editorial breakdown where top rated seniors dissect Graph DP, Segment Trees, and Greedy traps.
events.prerequisites: Active CodeChef ID & basic familiarity with Arrays, Sorting, and Recursion.

agenda.stage: Contest Live on CodeChef Platform (7 Problems)
Live Problem Solving & TLE Roast Session

events.title: Ship It Fast: Next.js, System Design & Production Deployment Lab
events.subtitle: Because "It Works On My Machine" is NOT an acceptable excuse in our kitchen.
events.description: A hands-on builder workshop by the Development Station! Learn how to architect modern React/Next.js apps, connect real-time APIs, design Linear-grade glassmorphism UIs, and deploy production pipelines on Vercel & Docker in under 120 minutes.
events.prerequisites: VS Code, Node.js installed, and a GitHub account.

agenda.stage: Architecture Deep Dive: Why 90% of Student Projects Look Basic
Live Code-Along: Building & Deploying an Interactive Dashboard
Live Repo Review & Instant PR Feedback + Swag Drop

events.title: Cooking with AI Agents: RAG, LLMs & Autonomous Workflows
events.subtitle: Move beyond basic ChatGPT wrappers and build multi-agent tools that execute real actions.
events.description: Dive into Gemini API, tool calling, vector embeddings, and autonomous workflows. Every participant leaves with a deployed AI Agent integrated into a live web interface.

agenda.stage: How Agentic Tool-Calling Works Under the Hood
Hands-On Build: Creating a Campus Concierge AI Agent

events.title: Chai, Commits & Career: GSoC, Off-Campus Internships & Open Source
events.subtitle: Unfiltered fireside chat with ABESEC alumni & seniors placed at top product companies.
events.venue: Main Open Air Theatre (OAT) / Raman Audi
events.description: How do you balance AKTU sessional exams, attendance, DSA, and high-impact development projects in your 2nd year? Join our most candid session of the semester with live resume & GitHub profile teardowns.
events.prerequisites: Bring your GitHub link & burning career questions.

agenda.stage: The 2nd-Year Roadmap: DSA vs Dev MythBusters
